source_user_requirements: 截图：宣传主图推荐1920×1080；横版封面460×215；竖版封面600×900。额外游戏图标未指定尺寸，采用1024×1024。无小鼠；沿用像素美术与适中色彩。
export: System.Drawing 仅按指定像素尺寸导出，保持比例，中心裁切仅为源图与目标比例的细微差异；不另改构图、颜色或文案。

prompts.main:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing existing game assets. This is official store/promotion artwork for the actual Chinese indie game 《病毒涌现》. Preserve the project's distinctive crisp 2D pixel-art sprite silhouettes and microscopic top-down setting: red host cells with pale kidney-shaped nuclei, many tiny amber-orange spiky viruses, cyan/grey-blue immune cells, midnight navy and plum fibrous organic tissue. Use balanced moderate saturation: wine/terracotta red, restrained amber, slate/cyan blue accents, antique champagne-gold type. Colors must be clear and alive, never dusty/grey, never fluorescent neon or burning oversaturated orange. Fine restrained old-gold ornamental linework fits game's existing card/UI style. No mouse, no rats, no animal body, no organs, no human, no gun, no laser, no invented awards, no store buttons, no QR, no watermark, no platform logos. This is campaign art, do not label as runtime screenshot. Exact Chinese title text is '病毒涌现'; do not insert English or alternate names. Keep safe margins and perfect legibility.
DELIVERABLE: main promotional key art, target 1920x1080, landscape 16:9. Image1 supplies established game style and palette ONLY, do not copy its many lines of text; images2 and3 supply exact virus and cell designs. Create a fresh, premium compact brand composition: dark open tissue cavity across left 40%, large ornate but highly readable gold Chinese logo '病毒涌现' there, all four characters in one line; a small single understated tagline below '微观策略 · 群体涌现'. Right 60% shows a richly detailed large red host cell clipped slightly by right edge, with swarms of MUCH SMALLER amber viruses curling around its membrane through a navy tissue channel. One cool blue-grey immune cell farther behind adds opposing color, not central. A few smaller cells on upper/lower borders provide depth; crisp pixel-art foreground, restrained depth blur only distant edges. Let actual game artwork fill canvas with no external picture frame. Logo occupies about 35% of canvas width, substantial dark space around it; nothing touching outer 7% safe margin. Rich but restrained colors, soft highlights; avoid bright white/cyan bloom, avoid thin cluttered arrows and fake HUD. Text ONLY the 4-character game title plus exact small tagline, no other slogans. Polished store key art, recognizable at thumbnail scale.
prompts.main_color_grade: Precise color grading edit ONLY of image1, a finished store key art. Image2 is the user's preferred campaign color reference. Preserve image1 EXACTLY in composition, all Chinese title text '病毒涌现' and subtitle '微观策略 · 群体涌现', fonts, logo, details, pixel-art shapes, object positions, framing. Image1 is TOO VIVID. Reduce selective saturation of orange, red, bright cyan by 25-30 percent and reduce bright rim/glow intensity by about20 percent, matching the moderate red/amber/slate-blue color richness of image2. Red host cell should become rich wine-red/terracotta, not scarlet; virus amber-orange, not fluorescent yellow-orange. Keep true deep navy background, clear color differentiation, crisp details and readable pale-gold lettering. Do not make it grey/dusty/desaturated monochrome. No new objects or text, no redesign, no extra blur. Single full image.
